checkout.title: Checkout

paymentMethod.title: Payment method
paymentMethod.stripeDescription: Pay securely with Stripe. Your payment is held in escrow until you confirm delivery.
paymentMethod.directDescription: Binance-P2P style. Arrange payment with the seller in chat and pay them directly. The platform does not verify funds — you pay at your own risk.
paymentMethod.directWarning: Direct payments are not protected by escrow. Only pay after agreeing with the seller in chat, and keep records of your payment.

buyerProtection.description: Your payment is held in escrow. The seller only receives the money after you confirm the plant arrived safely. If there's a problem, you can open a dispute within 48 hours.
